scope: Offline vocabulary-only editorial screen of emphasized headings, tables, figure labels and selected body names; no quota, no every-body-word or exhaustive clinical coverage claim.

source_wording_notes.normalization: Case, line-wrap hyphens, spacing and abbreviated figure labels normalized. No source instructions, numeric settings, clinical relationships or narrative copied.
source_wording_notes.source_match: heading_and_body means actual heading and prose; table_and_body means actual table and prose; figure_label includes text embedded in Figure29B-6 flowchart. Figure labels are vocabulary only, not algorithm transcription.
source_wording_notes.PEEP: Accepted peep/PEEP partial-name wordplay is a LOCAL29B reconsideration only. Chapter28's expanded-name arrow/gauge hold remains OPEN, not resolved or adjudicated here. Expansion must be taught; no mode or physiological claim.
source_wording_notes.pulmonary compliance: Entry uses source-exact lung compliance from Figure29B-3 caption49; reuses Chapter28 pulmonary-compliance family. Earlier author draft used pulmonary compliance at48, which was not source-exact; corrected before final handoff.
source_wording_notes.supplementary: Regular-body terms are labeled supplementary, not falsely emphasized; priority remains meaningful headings/table labels/figure labels.
source_wording_notes.abbreviated label: Insp. Hold is the visually verified raster-only abbreviated Figure29B-1 monitor label, not extractable PDF text or a contiguous expanded phrase. Source location relies on raster inspection, not normalizer proof.
source_wording_notes.cardiac failure: Chapter20 congestive-heart-failure traffic-jam hold remains unresolved. This chapter's unqualified cardiac-failure broken-heart category is narrower lexical composition without congestion and does not silently resolve that earlier hold.
source_wording_notes.generic category limits: Nodules reuses Chapter28 masses clay-lump family rather than counting another new category. Obstructive-lung cue drops COPD hourglass; thromboembolism cue drops pulmonary-embolism lung modifier, disclosed explicitly.

keyword_screen.typography_limits: Fonts/layout are evidence of typographic emphasis, not medical salience. Figure screenshots contain small rasterized monitor labels not all exposed as text spans; meaningful peak/plateau/PEEP/flow labels visually checked. Not exhaustive body-word or clinical-concept coverage.
